items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: So then Mr. Moran told him, he's gonna show him how he makes the carnival parades down there.

ctx.x: Well I guess that's just made him feel good. That's right.

You'd be surprised when you do some people. You know what he told me? He told me, he said, well I just come in Joseph. He's from New York. He said, I've been around places. When I never seen a place Mr. Commander got us to play. When the same girl watched his name find him about nine times. So then Mr. Moran told him, he's gonna show him how he makes the carnival parades down there. Well all the guests, white girls and white boys, they're all in applause.
